source_anchors.excerpt: The handler reads the optional `name` field and returns a greeting.

findings.rationale: greet() uses payload.get("name", "world") to read the optional `name` field and returns f"Hello, {name}". Both the named-field path and the default path are exercised by tests. The implementation directly satisfies REQ-TRIAGE-007 with no observable drift. DR-006 conditions are met: behavioral contract is unchanged, tests are green, and no requirement drift is present.

This project source does not require runtime schema validation.

findings.rationale: SRC-TRIAGE-007-EXT (authority: external_guidance) recommends validating untrusted request payloads against an explicit runtime schema. The implementation performs no schema validation. However, SRC-TRIAGE-007-PRD (authority: product_contract) explicitly states this project source does not require runtime schema validation. DR-004 forbids classifying this as CONFIRMED_ISSUE because only external guidance supports the claim. DR-012 applies: POTENTIAL_RISK with finding_type UNSUPPORTED_BEST_PRACTICE_CLAIM and only_external_guidance_supports_claim == true yields severity MEDIUM. The PRD note does not constitute an authoritative conflict — it is an explicit scope exclusion that resolves the tension. No ABSTAIN trigger arises.
